title: Profile
body: A person sets a display name of at most 100 characters and a bio of at most 1000 characters; either may be empty. ^bzhw
The server checks the same limits, so a request that does not come from the page cannot store a longer text. ^5mqw
Save changes stores only the fields that changed. Leaving the page with unsaved changes asks for a confirmation first. ^vnzw
An empty display name, bio or avatar is stored as not set, so the account page shows the name from Logto instead of an empty one. ^dr9z
